name: wisply-local
description: Read-only access to your Wisply memos, transcript excerpts, live transcript and action items from Codex on the Mac running Wisply. Talks only to the Wisply app on 127.0.0.1.

hooks.description: No hooks in Codex. The mod in hooks/ (status line, quote button, slash commands) runs only in Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Ask Codex about your Wisply recordings, read-only, on this Mac.
interface.longDescription: Lists your Wisply memos, searches transcript excerpts, reads the live transcript of a recording in progress and pulls the action items Wisply generated. It talks only to the Wisply app on 127.0.0.1:51771, sends the token only after Wisply proves its identity, and can't record, change settings or act for you.
defaultPrompt: List my last five Wisply memos.
What action items came out of my latest Wisply meeting?
What has been said so far in the meeting I'm recording in Wisply?
